expanded_prompts.normal-prompt-v2.txt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: an original full-body creature sprite for a hand-drawn 2D creature-raising game.
Create exactly one isolated creature from this independent design brief. Use clear dark colored variable-weight outlines, clean three-step cel shading, soft upper-left light, restrained material texture. No photorealism or 3D render.
Technical canvas: exactly 1024 by 1024 pixels, PNG RGBA with genuine transparent alpha. Center the entire creature with its longest extent between 768 and 896 pixels; leave at least 64 fully transparent pixels on every side. Transparent background, no checkerboard, scenery, ground, cast shadow, glow halo, text, lettering, labels, logo, watermark, border, costume, held objects or extra creatures. Body glow must stay inside its contour. Avoid human forms and recognizable existing characters.

Body and exact anatomy: Three shallow flattened oval pools of softly luminous solid translucent material connect along a gentle arc to form one continuous low creature. Exactly four small broad contact pads beneath the arc. No face and zero eyes. No box shape, lid, handle, separate head, or tail.
Fixed counts: eyes 0, feet 4, wings 0, tails 0.
Palette placement: oval upper lobes #E2B982; four pads #B078B4; restrained internal highlights #DBEFF0.
Pose: Low resting posture, slight top-down three-quarter view facing image-right, with all three oval lobes and four contact pads legible.
Keep every declared part clearly countable; do not add other parts. This must be one full-body sprite only.
expanded_prompts.pixel-prompt-attempt001.txt:
Use case: style-transfer
Input image 1 is the exact normal illustration identity reference. Redraw this SAME creature as deliberate authentic game pixel art. Change only the rendering medium. Never downsample, pixelation-filter or redesign the creature.
Locked anatomy: Three shallow flattened oval pools of softly luminous solid translucent material connect along a gentle arc to form one continuous low creature. Exactly four small broad contact pads beneath the arc. No face and zero eyes. No box shape, lid, handle, separate head, or tail.
Locked counts: {"eyes": 0, "feet": 4, "wings": 0, "tails": 0}
Locked palette roles: oval upper lobes #E2B982; four pads #B078B4; restrained internal highlights #DBEFF0
Locked pose: Low resting posture, slight top-down three-quarter view facing image-right, with all three oval lobes and four contact pads legible.
Rendering contract: a native 128 by 128 pixel PNG RGBA sprite on an exact 128 by 128 integer pixel grid. No more than 32 total visible colors. Only fully opaque pixels (alpha 255) and fully transparent pixels (alpha 0). Every edge must use carefully placed hard square pixel clusters and controlled staircase contours; no antialiasing, smooth curves, gradients, blur, glows, semitransparency, subpixel edges or arbitrary block sizes. 1–2 logical pixel dark contour. Flat limited-color shading and intentional readable clusters, not a tiny painted illustration.
Composition: same body silhouette, relative dimensions, facing and identity as reference, full body centered. Longest extent 96–112 logical pixels, at least 8 transparent pixels on every side. If a larger canvas is unavoidable, it must be a pixel-perfect exact integer enlargement of the same 128x128 logical image, with every logical pixel an identical size opaque square. Preserve the exact geometry of a 128x128 grid.
No text, labels, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, background, drawn checkerboard, ground, cast shadow, frame, scenery, new appendages or other creatures. Translate translucent or glossy cues to opaque limited-color clusters; do not make holes in the body. Produce one sprite only.
